question: Does reinforcement learning optimization on lower-hop QA instances transfer effectively to improve performance on higher-hop multi-hop QA?
description: The idea proposes to apply RL-based optimization on lower-hop QA after the repair stage and evaluate transfer to deeper multi-hop queries. It is unclear whether the learned policy from lower-hop tasks generalizes to higher-hop reasoning.
rationale: Transfer learning in KGQA, especially across different hop levels via RL, has not been extensively explored in the retrieved work.
